chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Soehan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Hammad ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Qasri said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'I fear that we may be praying the Friday prayer before the sun has passed its zenith.' He said, 'This is upon the callers to prayer (mu'adhdhins).'

key_terms.زَوَال الشَّمْس: The passing of the sun from its zenith (noon), marking the start of the Friday prayer time

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for ensuring the Friday prayer is performed at the correct time according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the permissibility of praying before the sun's zenith is contingent upon the Mu'adhdhin's call, distinguishing the congregants' duty from the caller's role in timing. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that the congregational Friday prayer is valid even if performed slightly before Zawal, provided the Adhan was issued at the appropriate time, emphasizing the Mu'adhdhin's pivotal role in establishing the prayer's temporal validity.
